title: DC The Batman Movie Batmobile 1:20 RC Radio Controlled 2022 Spin Master
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Radio Control & Control Line:RC Model Vehicles & Kits:Cars, Trucks & Motorcycles
descriptionText:
Get ready to control the DC The Batman Movie BATMOBILE with this 1:20 RC radio-controlled drag car from Spin Master. The black color and sleek design make it a perfect addition to any collection. This product is suitable for children aged 4-7 and does not require any prior experience with radio control vehicles.

The Batmobile is a iconic vehicle from the DC universe and this Spin Master product is a great way to bring it to life. It is manufactured in China and is part of the Spin Master product line. With the ability to control the vehicle from a distance, this toy is perfect for imaginative play. Add this to your collection today!
